name: memkit
description: Injects pointers to your own memory files into every prompt: lexical retrieval over a tiered markdown store, plus a checker and an eval for it.

memkitConfig.title: memkit config file
memkitConfig.description: Absolute path to the JSON config naming your memory stores. The plugin is inert until this file exists — /memkit:init creates it at the default path below. Nothing is read from your machine before then.
